source.licence: CC-BY-4.0 compilation; each source repository keeps its own licence

privacy: counts, ids, SHAs, file paths and sha256 hashes of texts only: no login, mention handle, e-mail address or verbatim text

stages.rule: repository (repository.url = pull_request.repo_url) has language Python, SPDX licence in {MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause}, is_forked false
inline review comments on S2 PRs (pull_request_url = repo_url || '/pulls/' || number)
user_type = 'User', in_reply_to_id IS NULL, author is not the PR's author account (case-insensitive) and does not end in [bot]
path ends in .py and diff_hunk is not empty
commit_id differs from original_commit_id, or position = 1 and original_position > 1
original_commit_id is among the PR's pr_commits rows and another commit of that PR first appears after it in file row order (heuristic: pr_commits has no dates or parents)
related_issue links the PR to an issue whose author is not a bot account
stages.primary_issue: the linked non-bot issue found in the PR body (source 'body') if any, else the lowest issue id

stages.rule: S7 without the linked-issue requirement: the initial request may be only the agent-written PR body, which is not user evidence
the first later commit is agent-attributed: author is a bot account (login ends in [bot] or has user_type 'Bot' on a review comment) or the message has an agent co-author trailer (applied to S8)
the first later commit is agent-attributed: author is a bot account (login ends in [bot] or has user_type 'Bot' on a review comment) or the message has an agent co-author trailer (applied to S8')

pr_to_repository.note: the funnel joins by URL as specified; repo_id is a cross-check

commit_order.heuristic: a commit of the PR whose first pr_commits row comes after the reviewed commit's first row is later
commit_order.note: live comments are those with position > 1; GitHub moves their commit_id to the PR head, so the share whose commit_id is the PR's last row estimates how often the last row is the head

bot_accounts.rule: login ends in [bot] (case-insensitive) or has user_type 'Bot' on a review comment

sample.rule: comment ids of S8 and S8a sorted by id; random.Random(seed).sample(ids, size_limit) if more survive, else all; if fewer than min_primary survive, topped up from S8 without S8a with the same generator
sample.hashes: sha256 of the UTF-8 comment body and issue body

path_owner_check.rule: the owner's name in a path is kept when the owner never authored a PR, review comment, issue or commit in AIDev (an organisation), else replaced by {owner}
